plain_description.what: Grows the embeddings-only tree (no declared subject labels) on almost all 12,000 MMLU-Pro questions instead of only the training share, and compares it with the train-only tree of record. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: Asks whether the tree's shape depends on how much data it is grown from: more leaves, a different first split, more certified splits?
plain_description.information: If more data gave a higher share of certified splits, data size would be a way to get a more trustworthy tree. If it only adds leaves, data is not the bottleneck. Result: done, structural evidence only. With the full corpus the tree has 36% more leaves and the same first split. More splits certify (18 vs 16), but a smaller share of them (19% vs 23%). On this corpus, data adds leaves but does not raise the certified share. This tree has seen the arena questions, so it may never be judged, used to write rubrics or published as a leaderboard.
